Overview.Name: G. Pooja
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer cubes (120 g) pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 2: Thick curd bowl + small fruit
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g) + paneer cubes (60 g)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_3 (Dinner - controlled): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)

Notes_and_Tips: For fried cravings, eat your regular meal first and wait 10 minutes before eating anything extra.
Start meals with paneer or curd to control overeating.
Avoid outside fried foods completely as they trigger loss of control.
Keep meals simple and follow a routine daily.
Managing stress will directly help reduce overeating and improve results.
